deck.title: Grass Journal — a journal that grows with you

props.title: A journal that ==grows== with you.
props.subtitle: Grass Journal is a gentle daily journaling app: write a little each day, and watch your practice take root.

slides.notes: Open softly. Grass Journal isn't another productivity tool — it's a small daily ritual that leaves something beautiful behind.

left.label: Today
left.title: Journaling apps today
points: Heavy setups and walls of prompts
So feature-packed that writing gets lost
Guilt builds, and people quietly quit

right.label: Needed
right.title: What actually keeps a habit
points: A calm, low-friction place to write
Progress you can ==see==, not points you can lose
Short entries, no pressure to be profound
A reason to come back tomorrow

slides.notes: Most journaling apps compete on features and streaks — which is exactly why people abandon them. The failure mode is guilt, not laziness.

props.caption: is about all it takes for most people to quit a journaling app — the practice never gets past the hardest days
props.foot: The habit dies before the reward ever shows up

slides.notes: Land the pain point: the drop-off happens in the first days, right when nothing visible has been earned yet. That's the gap Grass Journal closes.

props.label: The idea
props.text: Journaling is ==gardening==. Each day's short entry is a blade of grass. Over weeks, your journal becomes a meadow — and your consistency is visible at a glance, ==without a single streak to lose==.

slides.notes: This is the heart of the pitch. A meadow never scolds you for the days it didn't rain — it just keeps growing. Same principle for the journal.

props.title: Open. Write a few lines. Done.

items.title: Open
items.body: One calm page greets you — no dashboards, no prompts demanding depth.

items.title: Write
items.body: A short daily entry. Two honest lines count as much as two pages.

items.title: Done
items.body: Close the app. Your meadow quietly grows one blade taller.

items.title: Return
items.body: The growing meadow is the reward — no guilt mechanics, no noisy gamification.

slides.notes: Walk through a whole day's session in under thirty seconds. Emphasize that the visualization reflects the days — it never judges them.

tiles.title: The meadow
tiles.body: A living growth view of your entries — consistency made visible at a glance.

tiles.title: Low-friction entries
tiles.body: Open to write in seconds; short entries are the intended use, not a shortcut.

tiles.title: No streaks, no shame
tiles.body: Missed days simply leave space. The meadow is patient with you.

tiles.title: Private by default
tiles.body: Your words are yours — a quiet place, not a feed.

slides.notes: Don't read every tile — call out the meadow as the signature feature, then let the rest breathe.

props.title: A working app, ==open source== and ready to try.
